title: Last Tape Cell After One Step
statement: Let $K$ be a natural number, let $M$ be a deterministic Turing machine with $K+1$ work tapes over the Boolean alphabet, and suppose that on every transition its last work tape either leaves the scanned cell unchanged or writes $1$. For every input, configuration $c$, and cell position $z\in\mathbb Z$, after one step the content of that cell on the last work tape is either its previous content or $1$.
hypotheses_covered: machine has $K+1$ work tapes and Boolean symbols
every transition on the last work tape either makes no write or writes $1$
